{{Top|leg}}
The '''Under-Barrel HH-4''' was an [[Under-barrel grenade launcher]] attachment used by [[Cold assault stormtrooper]]s. They saw use during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], where they were frequently used for dealing with targets besides the primary target.
